manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The round trip is machine-proven; the palette icons on screen after a real Save/Reopen are yours to confirm.

items.step: Lock Gems, hide Metals, Save, close and reopen the file.
items.machine_proven: K1: both groups' slots come back with locked/visible and the slot colours.
items.human_must_verify: The palette shows the same lock and visibility icons as before saving.

items.step: After the reopen, click the locked Gems row and the hidden Metals row.
items.machine_proven: K3: nothing is selected from either row, and the object ids are the same as before saving.
items.human_must_verify: No objects jump into the selection, and the ids/colours you had are still there.

items.step: Open a different file in the same session.
items.machine_proven: L1: the previous slots are absent and select nothing.
items.human_must_verify: The palette shows the new file's layers only — no leftover rows.

items.step: Try to open a file that does not exist.
items.machine_proven: L2: the current document and its flags are untouched.
items.human_must_verify: The palette keeps the current state and the error is explained.
